messages:
Sam Patel: Morning team — quick heads-up: I'll be OOO next Wed-Fri, can we swap ARB chairing for the 3/25 session? Prefer someone to handle RFC reviews + one design deep-dive. Thanks! :wave:
Tanya Huang: I can take it if no one else. What time are we keeping? 11am PT still?
Lee Rivera: 11am PT fine for me. Is this the RFC-420 (kv-cache eviction) on the docket?
Sam Patel: yes, RFC-420 + design review for "infer-runtime batching heuristics". If Tanya can chair, would you take RFC-420 or the design deep-dive?
Tanya Huang: I can do RFC-420, prefer the shorter slot. Can Morgan take the deep-dive?
Morgan Chen: happy to run the deep-dive. I'll prep a 12min walkthrough + 8min Q&A. Can we shorten intros to 2m?
Sam Patel: nice — agenda outline below. Also can we push a quick pre-read thread to #eng-platform 48h before? add links pls.
Sam Patel: Agenda (proposed):
```
- 11:00 - 11:05 quick sync + accept minutes
- 11:05 - 11:25 RFC-420 (presenter: Tanya) — 10m + 10m discussion
- 11:25 - 11:45 Deep-dive: batching heuristics (presenter: Morgan) — 12m + 8m
- 11:45 - 11:55 standards check: kernel selection guidelines (5m)
- 11:55 - 12:00 action items + parking lot
```
Lee Rivera: kernel selection check — I'll bring notes from infra runbook.
Tanya Huang: I'll post the RFC doc + short changelog link: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/420
Morgan Chen: adding slides to the meeting invite now. prefer remote-only? or quick whiteboard?
Sam Patel: remote-only for this one. Morgan — can you add screenshots for perf curves and the golden prompt we used?
Morgan Chen: yes. will upload by EOD Tue.
CI Bot: Meeting invite created for 2026-03-25 11:00 PT — attendees: eng-platform, eng-runtime. Calendar link: https://calendar.redwood.com/meet/ARB-0325
Tanya Huang: also tagging @security for the kernel selection item. @security — any known blockers?
Security: not aware of blockers, but pls attach threat model snippet.
Sam Patel: perfect. If nobody objects, swap confirmed: Tanya chair + Morgan deep-dive. I'll update the ARB rotation doc.
Lee Rivera: thanks Sam. :thumbsup:
Tanya Huang: got it — I'll take chair prep. ping me if you want me to run the pre-read thread.
Sam Patel: will do. thanks all.
